title: Smoking-Stratified Signal Decomposition and Feature Selection for Never-Smoker Cancer Classification in a Combined Lung-Breast Metabolomics Cohort.
snippet: Metabolomic cancer classifiers trained on mixed-smoking cohorts may embed tobacco exposure signal within their predictions, degrading performance in never-smokers, a population in which lung adenocarcinoma is frequently diagnosed.
